brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Something to keep sewing supplies tidy - organized storage with compartments
requirements.evidence: 3 hex cells with 7 compartments total: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) + bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2) + bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2). Bins sit in cells 0,0,0 + 0,1,0 + 1,0,0, capped and bolted.

Prop catalog has no sewing props (thread, fabric, scissors, needles returned 0 results). Dressed with workshop proxies: screwdriver (seam ripper/scissors stand-in in bin 0,0,0) and electrical tape (thread spool in bin 1,0,0) to show compartment function. Tidy separation visible in build.

finish.summary: L-shaped 3-cell organizer with 7 divided compartments provides tidy sewing storage. Sewing-specific props unavailable in catalog, demonstrated with workshop proxies; compartments clearly organize small notions.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
**Build complete:** 3-cell L-shaped organizer with divided bins for sewing notions.

* **Structure:** 3 hex cells (0,0,0 + 0,1,0 + 1,0,0) bolted with joint bolts, outer faces capped
* **Storage:**
  * Cell 0,0,0 - **hex-bin-full-div3** (3 compartments) - for small notions: buttons, needles, pins, bobbins
  * Cell 0,1,0 - **hex-bin-full-div2** (2 compartments) - for tools: scissors, tape measure, ruler
  * Cell 1,0,0 - **hex-bin-full-div2** (2 compartments) - for thread/spools, tape, elastic

Props dressed to show use (screwdriver as stand-in for seam ripper/scissors, electrical tape for thread spool, tape measure concept) - sewing-specific props (thread spools, fabric, scissors, needles) are not in the prop catalog, so generic workshop tools demonstrate the compartment function. Bins sit above rim and are clearly visible from angle, showing tidy separation.

Mesh check: clear. Print estimate 1623g / 2229 min / 18 parts.
